text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government decides to widen the area of the capital Algiers to cover neighbouring Tipaza province, in step to improve management of facilities for residents.
- European Union continues pouring money into the Algerian economy despite the country's political and security crises.
- Statements from Morocco and Libya attack Algeria's sovereignty over borders. Should do this lead to reviewing political relations with these countries?
- The authorities plan to put off roads vehicles which are more than 15 years old.
- Independent committee to oversee the June 5 parliamentary elections will be installed on Thursday.
- The financial authorities plan wide restructuring in the banking system.
- Algeria celebrates March 19 as a victory day.
